description: The task type the Tasks plugin declares. The plugin's tests run each case through workspace-format's generic validator and serializer with the plugin's schema, and plugin-host's tests check that the running plugin registers this schema. The property cases moved here from the task_properties section of conformance-v1.json, with the results the kernel's task rules gave, and from the task_schema_differences section of object-envelope-v1.json, both in docs/workspace-format/fixtures.

task due must be a civil date or offset timestamp
task due must be a real civil date
task project references use stable IDs
a due date that isn't a string
a due value that is a boolean
a project reference that isn't a string
a project reference that is a list
a kanban_order that isn't a string
